description: Jicoo helps authorized team members inspect bookings, schedules, event types, routing forms, host assignment rules, organization users, meeting artifacts, and webhook endpoint settings through ChatGPT. It also supports creating or updating booking, schedule, event type, routing form, host assignment, and webhook configuration records when the user explicitly asks to make those changes.
